title: Booking Round
description: One round on a seller's published booking calendar for an airing or publication window: buying opens, a request round closes, and the seller confirms later. Unlike installment.deadlines.booking_deadline (the hard close for one installment), a round also says what happens to a request after request_deadline. Order: opens_at < request_deadline <= booking_deadline; request_deadline <= expected_confirmation_at. booking_deadline MUST NOT be later than that of any installment covered. Applies only when the flight falls inside one covers window. Experimental sketch for WG review.

round_id.description: Identifier for this round, unique within the product.

covers.description: Airing or publication window this round books, for example one calendar month. Calendar dates in the seller's timezone.

opens_at.description: When buying opens for this round (ISO 8601).

request_deadline.description: Soft close of the request round (ISO 8601). A request received after this is governed by late_request_handling.

booking_deadline.description: Hard close (ISO 8601), as installment.deadlines.booking_deadline: after it the seller accepts no new requests for this round. When absent, late requests stay open until an installment's own booking_deadline.

expected_confirmation_at.description: When the seller expects to confirm requests in this round (ISO 8601). An estimate, not a commitment. A submitted create_media_buy response for a request in this round SHOULD carry this as its expected_confirmation_at.

late_request_handling.description: Treatment of a request received after request_deadline and before booking_deadline.

late_request_pricing_option_id.description: Pricing option on the same product that prices an accepted late request, with the late rate in its own binding price (so it stays inside terms_digest). 3.4 candidate: a round-keyed price_adjustments dimension (#7659 / #7955). Not meaningful when late_request_handling is rejected.
